earnings.title: SCHWAB DELIVERS RECORD NET NEW ASSETS & EARNINGS
highlights: Record GAAP Earnings Per Share of $1.62; $1.69 Adjusted (1) – Up 29% versus 3Q25
WESTLAKE, Texas, October 15, 2026 – The Charles Schwab Corporation reported net income for the third quarter totaling $2.9 billion, or earnings per share of $1.62.
Excluding $151 million of pre-tax transaction-related costs, adjusted (1) net income and earnings per share equaled $3.0 billion and $1.69, respectively.
3Q Net Revenues Reached a Record $7.2 Billion, Up 17% Year-Over-Year
